plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Fortinet FortiMail email security gateways (PEN 12356, tree 1.3.6.1.4.1.12356.105). Besides standard IF-MIB 64-bit interface traffic, it collects CPU and memory utilization and log / mail disk usage (all %).
name: Firewall

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: Uptime of the FortiMail gateway since the last restart (IF-MIB sysUpTime), in seconds.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Instantaneous CPU utilization of the FortiMail gateway (FORTINET-FORTIMAIL-MIB fmlSysCpuUsage, Gauge32 percent). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Instantaneous memory utilization of the FortiMail gateway (FORTINET-FORTIMAIL-MIB fmlSysMemUsage, Gauge32 percent). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_log_disk_usage
metrics.description: Log disk utilization of the FortiMail gateway (FORTINET-FORTIMAIL-MIB fmlSysLogDiskUsage, Gauge32 percent). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_mail_disk_usage
metrics.description: Mail disk utilization of the FortiMail gateway (FORTINET-FORTIMAIL-MIB fmlSysMailDiskUsage, Gauge32 percent). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: Average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: Average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter.
